data.display_address: Damac Riverside - Ivy, Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover Riverside, an exceptional development by Damac Properties in the heart of the Damac Riverside community. Inspired by the architecture of world-famous cities like Rome, Paris, London, New York, and Amsterdam, Riverside offers luxurious 4 and 5-bedroom townhomes.

Key Features and Amenities:
Riverside’s exclusive facilities are spread across two distinct zones: Water Vein and Green Vein. At Water Vein, residents can enjoy water fitness areas, a rock climbing wall, an essential oil lake, an opera stage, an on-water cinema, and dining at two fine restaurants. Green Vein offers unique spaces for cooking classes, hydroponic farms, a zen spa, barbecue zones, relaxation rooms, and an amphitheater. The community also includes a clubhouse with a gym, co-working spaces, a bowling alley, an arcade, and an outdoor cinema.

Ideal Location:
Located between Jebel Ali Al-Hibab Road and Emirates Road, Riverside is conveniently close to major attractions. It’s just 25 minutes from Palm Jebel Ali, 24 minutes from Dubai Marina, and only 10 minutes from both Damac Lagoons and Al Maktoum International Airport, offering residents quick access to Dubai’s vibrant lifestyle.
